Author: Manoj Kumar Garg Bench: Manoj Kumar Garg [2023/RJJD/007256]

sentences.text: Smt. Kalawati W/o Sh. Vijendra Kumar Swami, Aged  About 54 Years, R/o Naya Kua, Bikaner.

2. Vijendra Kumar Swami S/o Sh. Satyanarayan Swami,
 Aged About 62 Years, R/o Naya Kua, Bikaner.

----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Mahendra Kumar Swami S/o Sh. Satyanarayan Swami,
 R/o Rani Bazar, Opp. Sabji Mandi, Bikaner.
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. M.S. Purohit For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, PP
Mr. S.K. Verma  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 22/03/2023

The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioners for quashing of FIR No.0147/2022, Police Station Kotwali, District Bikaner for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468,
471, 406 & 120B of IPC.

Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report dated 21.03.2023 received from the SHO, Police Station Kotwali, District Bikaner, wherein it has been mentioned that Police is going to submit a Final Report in this case.
The said report is hereby taken on record.

[2023/RJJD/007256] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-8683/2022] In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.
Stay application also stands dismissed.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 143-raksha/-
